fact: Article 35 of the 2026 finance-law fiscal annex (promulgated 19 December 2025) exempts labelled startups for three years, and on 9 February 2026 CDC-CI Capital and the Agence Emploi Jeunes signed a convention for an initial FCFA 1.05 billion to fund prototyping and seed investment.
title: Côte d’Ivoire : la Startup Act entre dans sa phase opérationnelle
